manualState.thermal: 未明显发热，温度未测量

shapeEvidence.evidence: mat4x4<f16> weights; src_s reduction loop; vec4<f16> accumulators with fma; workgroup reduction
shapeEvidence.dtype: FP16 vector weights/accumulators; FP32 texture load/store conversion
shapeEvidence.layout: Packed mat4x4<f16> buffer, texture coordinates and symbolic U.i0 strides; global row-major M/N/K UNKNOWN
shapeEvidence.parameters: Eight unrolled vec4<f16> accumulators, src_s += 4, workgroup temp[32]; actual WG override constants UNKNOWN
shapeEvidence.equivalence: This FP32 dense non-fused GEMM is not an equivalent runtime replacement; no model speedup claim

input.algorithm: Reuse GEMM001 xorshift32, A then B independently per shape/family

reference.method: Same GEMM001 independent i-k-j CPU Float64Array accumulation from stored FP32 inputs
reference.difference: CPU binary64 versus GPU FP32/possible FMA
reference.crossVariant: compare tiled(actual) against naive(expected) with same family atol/rtol; no bitwise-equality requirement for fractional inputs

timing.warmupOrder: 10 alternating naive-first/tiled-first rounds, both variants warm once each round
timing.gpuBoundary: One compute dispatch between timestampWrites begin/end; query resolve/C copy outside pass
timing.wallBoundary: Immediately before queue.submit to onSubmittedWorkDone completion; includes resolve/copies, excludes map/check
timing.serialProtocol: Previous pass completed and query/C fully mapped and unmapped before next submission; safely reuse query indices0,1
timing.setup: Both pipelines, shared inputs/uniform/reference and independent C buffers outside sampling loops
timing.controls: Same device, A/B/CPU reference, C usage and readback protocol; only kernel/workgroup/shared-memory scheme differ
timing.changes: naive8x8 versus tiled16x16+2048 bytes workgroup memory and two barriers per K tile
timing.statistics: GEMM001 measured-only midpoint median/nearest-rank p95/min/max/zero/GCD and resolution rule
timing.primarySpeedup: Same-run naive median / same-run tiled median; no historical denominator

historicalContext.usage: Background only, never used in speedup

naive.resolutionPolicy: RESOLUTION_LIMITED if any measured zero or median < 10*max(priorGrid, observedGCD); GCD is finite-sample evidence, not hardware resolution
naive.flopConvention: 2*M*N*K counts one multiply + one add per K, including conventional initial addition
naive.effectiveGflopsMeaning: Nominal FLOPs divided by compute-pass median ns; not pure arithmetic time, hardware peak utilization or bottleneck proof

tiled.resolutionPolicy: RESOLUTION_LIMITED if any measured zero or median < 10*max(priorGrid, observedGCD); GCD is finite-sample evidence, not hardware resolution
tiled.flopConvention: 2*M*N*K counts one multiply + one add per K, including conventional initial addition
tiled.effectiveGflopsMeaning: Nominal FLOPs divided by compute-pass median ns; not pure arithmetic time, hardware peak utilization or bottleneck proof

statistics.primaryDefinition: Same-run naive pass median / same-run tiled pass median; historical GEMM001 not used
statistics.pairedRatioDefinition: Statistics of 30 within-round naive/tiled duration ratios; different estimator from ratio of medians

naive.resolutionPolicy: RESOLUTION_LIMITED if any measured zero or median < 10*max(priorGrid, observedGCD); GCD is finite-sample evidence, not hardware resolution
naive.flopConvention: 2*M*N*K counts one multiply + one add per K, including conventional initial addition
naive.effectiveGflopsMeaning: Nominal FLOPs divided by compute-pass median ns; not pure arithmetic time, hardware peak utilization or bottleneck proof

tiled.resolutionPolicy: RESOLUTION_LIMITED if any measured zero or median < 10*max(priorGrid, observedGCD); GCD is finite-sample evidence, not hardware resolution
tiled.flopConvention: 2*M*N*K counts one multiply + one add per K, including conventional initial addition
tiled.effectiveGflopsMeaning: Nominal FLOPs divided by compute-pass median ns; not pure arithmetic time, hardware peak utilization or bottleneck proof

statistics.primaryDefinition: Same-run naive pass median / same-run tiled pass median; historical GEMM001 not used
statistics.pairedRatioDefinition: Statistics of 30 within-round naive/tiled duration ratios; different estimator from ratio of medians

limitations: Representative shapes, not recovered runtime shapes; no model or Adreno speedup claim
Source facts about loads/barriers are not measured reuse/occupancy/cache/DRAM evidence
Serial readback, pairing, CPU checks and order affect run state; one-run comparison is preliminary
M=1 slowdown allowed; no tile/precision/vectorization/algorithm auto-tuning
